stem.text: Some students investigated the effect of pH on the rate of starch digestion by amylase at $20\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.

items: They added $2\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of a 1% amylase solution and $1\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of pH4 buffer to a test-tube.
They added $2\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of a starch solution, containing $0.02\,\text{g}$ of starch, to the test-tube.
They measured the time taken for the starch to be digested (to disappear).

stem.text: The students then repeated these steps with pH5, pH6, pH7 and pH8 buffers.
